query: questions to ask an intern candidate
sub: 15 questions, and what good answers sound like

steps.title: Warm-up
points: What made you apply for this role?
What do you know about what we do?
What are you studying, and what do you enjoy most?
steps.tip: Start easy. Nervous candidates give better answers once they relax.

steps.title: Motivation
points: What do you hope to learn here?
Which part of the role excites you most?
Where would you like to be in two years?
steps.tip: Listen for curiosity about the work, not just the company name.

steps.title: Skills and experience
points: Tell me about a project you're proud of.
Which tools are you confident with?
How do you organise a busy week?
steps.tip: Ask for one real example. Specifics beat buzzwords.

steps.title: Working with others
points: Tell me about a group project that went wrong.
How do you like to get feedback?
When would you ask for help?
steps.tip: Good interns ask questions early. That is a strength, not a weakness.

steps.title: Their questions
points: What would you like to know about the team?
Is there anything we haven't asked you?
What would make this internship great for you?
steps.tip: Their questions show how seriously they have thought about the role.

cta_sub: Save these 15 questions for your next interview.

captions.linkedin:
Interviewing an intern? Here are 15 questions worth asking.

Warm-up: why this role, what they know about you, what they enjoy studying
Motivation: what they want to learn, what excites them, where they see themselves
Skills: a project they're proud of, the tools they know, how they plan a week
Teamwork: a group project that went wrong, how they take feedback, when they ask for help
Their questions: what they want to know, and what would make the internship great

Listen for real examples and genuine curiosity.
